verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents custom pricing plans and several usage-based pricing models, with meter events for billing on usage and Dashboard-based subscription creation. Community evidence confirms per-user, per-usage and per-tier models. The evidence does not distinguish volume from graduated tiers, does not cover credits, commitments or overage, and sending meter events implies integration code. Missing for 10: explicit volume vs graduated tier documentation, credits/prepaid balances, minimum commitments, overage pricing, explicit hybrid subscription-plus-usage configuration, and evidence that usage pricing works end-to-end without custom code.
